source_dataset: 2025 IEPR Gas Rate Forecast workbook tn=264063, scenario 'GT AAFS 2.5 Demand Flat RR' (aggressive electrification + BAU/Flat revenue recovery)
basis_note: REAL 2024$ (tn=264063 delivered price; the workbook's 'Commodity Prices' sheet is headed '2024$/Therm'). Previously mislabeled 'nominal'; corrected 2026-09-09. The export bundle inflates this to nominal via the GDP deflator to match the nominal-basis bundle; the notebook plots it with native='real_2024'.
scenario: GT AAFS 2.5 (Additional Achievable Fuel Substitution) demand decline + Flat RR recovery (business-as-usual gas investment). The most extreme published PG&E residential death-spiral case.
note: The most extreme, and most current, official state death-spiral figure -- driven by the assumption that gas-system INVESTMENT is NOT curtailed as demand falls (contrast E3 2020's managed high-electrification path, ~$13.8/therm nominal by 2050 / ~$7.8 real 2024$). Applies to PG&E residential.

citation.note: Confirms the earlier ~$102.76/therm figure (= this scenario's 2050 delivered price).
